TS055 trailing-comma

A wrapped list ends with a trailing comma, so the formatter keeps one element per line and the next element is a one-line change.

languages: javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: info
default: opt-in
group: stable
go: the Go grammar requires the trailing comma when the closing delimiter starts a new line, so a wrapped list without one does not compile

TigerStyle: "To wrap a function signature, call or data structure, add a trailing comma, close your eyes and let `zig fmt` do the rest."
